LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 6.3.1 WORD CLASSES: ADVERBS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3: Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important to describe where, when and how events happen?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify adverbs of time, place, and manner in texts
2. use adverbs of time, place, and manner in different contexts

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 6.3.1 WORD CLASSES: ADVERBS
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs for Grade 7 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify adverbs of time, place, and manner in texts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use adverbs of time, place, and manner in different contexts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to describe where, when and how events happen?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify adverbs of time, place, and manner in texts
2. use adverbs of time, place, and manner in different contexts

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
